def move(terrain, start, duration_s, n_runs, seed):
    import numpy as np
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    # time array shape (60,), linearly spaced from 0 to duration_s
    times = np.linspace(0, duration_s, 60)
    # Initialize output array: (n_runs, 60, 3)
    points = np.empty((n_runs, 60, 3), dtype=float)
    # Fill latitude, longitude with start repeated, seconds_elapsed with times broadcast
    points[:, :, 0] = start[0]
    points[:, :, 1] = start[1]
    points[:, :, 2] = times

    # All points are fixed, subject stationary at start position.
    # Check if start is inside terrain box
    ok = terrain.inside(start[0]*np.ones(n_runs), start[1]*np.ones(n_runs))

    return points, ok
